notes.title: The XGen Studios Bundle now includes Defend Your Castle!
notes.notes:
We just brought one of our classic games to the Steam platform: Defend Your Castle. You might have gotten in trouble for playing the web version of this game in your computer lab or library at school when you probably were supposed to be studying or researching something important. Sorry teachers! Defend Your Castle is now available alongside Super Motherload (& Motherload Goldium Edition), Stick RPG 2 and The Low Road at a 30% discount if you get them together! Check out the bundle here:

http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/3347/XGen_Studios_Bundle/

Or if you're just looking for a quick dose of nostalgia hop on over to the DYC store page here:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/708710/Defend_Your_Castle/

We also just launched both sound tracks for The Low Road on Steam: [i]Songs On The Low Road[/i] by Win Well and [i]The Low Road OST[/i] by Eric Cheng. You can pick them both up in The Low Road Soundtrack Bundle at 30% off regular price (oh and there's a 30% launch discount too... so let's just say CHEAP!).

http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/4978/The_Low_Road_Soundtrack_Bundle/

Most of all, thank you for playing our games!

- The XGen Studios Team

notes.title: The XGen Studios Bundle!
notes.notes:
Hello Stick RPG 2 fans! We've bundled together all of our Steam games into one package! If you have already purchased Super Motherload that means you can complete the set by adding Super Motherload and Motherload Goldium Edition (included with Super Motherload) for a discount!

http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/3347/XGen_Studios_Bundle/

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6166376/7e02cde4bba2642048c3530ddc07de34e28bbe00.png[/img]

The XGen Bundle includes:

[b]Stick RPG 2:[/b] Build up your Stats and Net Worth, collect the mysterious trans-dimensional artifacts, solve the mysteries of Paper Thin City and find your way home.

[b]Motherload Goldium Edition:[/b] Included with Super Motherload, Mothlerload Goldium Edition is the 2004 cult classic flash game that inspired games like Inifiniminer.

[b]Super Motherload:[/b] “An awesome blend of obsessive compulsive profiteering and addictive, satisfying gameplay.” 4.5 / 5 – Game Revolution

notes.title: 50% OFF Stick RPG 2!
notes.notes:
In celebration of launching our Steam page for The Low Road, we’re offering 50% discount on Super Motherload and Stick RPG 2! We’re so excited to share with you our corporate espionage themed point and click adventure on April 20th, but until then we hope you enjoy digging to the depths of Mars and exploring the streets of Paper Thin City. 

The discount runs from March 16th until March 19th at 10 am PST. 

Thanks for all of your support!  

- XGen Studios  

The Low Road (April 20th): http://store.steampowered.com/app/603700/
Super Motherload (50% off): http://store.steampowered.com/app/269110/
Stick RPG 2 (50% off): http://store.steampowered.com/app/307640/
